# vampiro

> Cross-language Rust CLI (v0.2.0) for checking whether code composes correctly at call and module boundaries. Supports Python, Clojure, Julia, and Rust via tree-sitter frontends.

## Genesis Adoption

vampiro uses the `genesis-vibes` v0.4 shared crate for cross-cutting infrastructure.
Currently adopted modules:

| Module | Status | Notes |
|--------|--------|-------|
| `config` | ✅ | ConfigFile, ConfigRegistry, ConfigStore |
| `doctor` | ✅ | DoctorCheck, DoctorRunner |
| `guide` | ✅ | Guide, CommandRegistry, ErrorSink |
| `managed_block` | ✅ | BlockDef, BlockInjector, BlockRegistry |
| `status` | ✅ | StatusContributor, StatusItem |
| `suite_linter` | ✅ | LintResult, Severity |
| `cli` | ✅ | `generate_completions`, `maybe_print_version_json` |
| `envelope` | ✅ | `Envelope<T>` for structured output |
| `feedback` | ✅ | `FeedbackArgs`, `handle_feedback` (scratch, redactor, gh) |
| `suggestions` | ✅ | `SuggestionEngine`, `CommandRegistry` for typo detection |
| `scaffold` | ✅ | `Scaffold` builder for `init` command |
| `discovery` | ✅ | `.genesis/tools.toml` manifest, `scan`, `register` |
| `fixture` | ✅ | `Fixture` builder for test environments |
| `aix` | ✅ | AIX artifact generation (agents block) |
## Authorship

All code in this repository was generated by a large language model. Human contribution: requirements, design decisions, planning, and review.
